title: Most People Miss This About Joseph Being Sent Alone
paragraphs: Most People Miss This About Joseph Being Sent Alone

Not by his father.
Not by his brothers.
By God.
In Genesis 37, Joseph walks alone into a field that would change everything. No backup. No warning. Just obedience.
And that’s where most people miss it.

It looks like betrayal.
It feels like isolation.
It sounds like silence.

They stripped him.
They threw him into a pit.
They sold him like he was nothing.
God will sometimes send you alone into places where your calling gets attacked.

Not because He left you.
But because He’s positioning you.

The pit wasn’t the end.
It was the doorway.
Years later, Joseph would say in Genesis 50:20:
“What you meant for evil… God meant for good.”

Man plotted pain.
God produced purpose.
But it was the greatest rescue mission in history.

Your sin.
My sin.
Paid in full.
So if you feel like you’ve been sent into something you don’t understand…
Don’t rush to call it abandonment.
God may be writing a story your future self will thank Him for.

The pit is not your identity.
The prison is not your ending.
The process is not your punishment.

Repent where you’ve doubted.
Trust where you’ve feared.
Receive the grace bought by Jesus alone.
